id: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales (2017)

facts.why: The Dying Gull is Jack's ship, not a tavern. The compass is traded in an unnamed local tavern on St Martin.
facts.fix: Aboard the Dying Gull, last call

facts.why: The film has Salazar's rotting ghost sharks, the VFX team built them, and the transcript has the 'Shark' cry in the sea chase.

facts.text: Ghost sharks of the Devil's Triangle
facts.why: The ghost sharks come with Salazar's crew, who are freed from the Devil's Triangle, so the wink is fair.

vibe.verdict: A dark bar tab with Salazar's line, the compass for rum cue, ghost sharks and Carina the horologist, but the vault and Pearl in a bottle are missing.
ideas: Swap the 'Dockside tavern' sign for 'Aboard the Dying Gull'.
Swap 'Steamed guava duff pudding' for a 'Bank vault pudding' with a gold coin.
Swap 'Parmesan thyme crisps' for 'Where's the dosh?' bar snacks (Scrum's line).
Swap the 'Reunion pork belly' note for Barbossa's last stand.
iconic: Dead men tell no tales (signed note)
Jack trades the compass for a bottle (cue, house drink)
Carina is a horologist, not a witch (house snack)
changed: Signed note now Salazar's real 'dead men tell no tales' line, replacing a made-up Jack line
Star map cracker note now says what the food is
Pork belly note now says what the food is
Wink: Scrum's 'where's the dosh' replaces Salazar's crew
